metadata.title: World's Biggest Data Breaches & Hacks
metadata.yearMeaning: Year the story broke, as labeled by the source sheet; retained without independently re-dating reports.
metadata.unit: Source-reported records; rows may describe accounts, personal records, documents or images. Not unique people.
metadata.scope: A curated collection of reported breaches, not a complete or representative census. Related reports may overlap; do not sum counts as unique people or infer a global incidence trend.
metadata.countPolicy: Prefer displayed-records numeric labels over the numeric plotting field. Keep explicit unknowns, uncorroborated possible placeholders, and incompatible system-count units null. Other source counts are reported, not independently verified.
metadata.placeholderPolicy: The source instructions allow 3m, 4m, 5m or 10m to approximate unknown counts. Without an explicit display label or matching quantity in the row's narrative, conservatively retain these as unresolved. This does not assert their true count is unknown.
metadata.categoryPolicy: Trim category whitespace, normalize academic/academia to Education, and retain multi-category records as Multiple sectors or Multiple methods; original values and component lists are retained.
